description: Close is a REST‑based platform that lets businesses organize and track leads, contacts, opportunities, activities, and custom fields throughout their sales pipeline.

access.credential_access: API key via HTTP Basic Auth

mcp.details: Close exposes an MCP server at https://mcp.close.com/mcp that AI clients connect to over HTTP using OAuth 2.0 (or an API key) with scoped permissions to read or modify Close data.
mcp.auth: Supports OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration or API‑key authentication via the Close‑API‑Key and Close‑Scope headers.

buildability.blocker: Developer signup / access process is undocumented in the sources reviewed.

evidence.claim: API Key authentication uses HTTP Basic Auth with the API key as username and empty password
An API key is a secret token used to authenticate requests
Close provides a documented public API
Close offers Webhooks for real-time data
API Keys authentication supported (use HTTP Basic Auth with API key as username)
Close provides an MCP server at https://mcp.close.com/mcp.
The MCP server supports HTTP Streamable and OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration.
Authentication can be performed via OAuth 2.0 or an API key using Close‑API‑Key and Close‑Scope headers.
